## Objective

What should this change accomplish?

## Scope

What is included in this Pull Request?

## Out of scope

What must not change?

## Decision architecture

Only for changes to user-facing copy, UX, pricing, notifications or promotions. Otherwise write N/A.
Framework: [Prospect Theory playbook](https://github.com/Nexar-Hub/.github/blob/main/docs/prospect-theory/PLAYBOOK.md).

- Reference point: where does the user think they stand today, and are we moving it on purpose?
- Lever(s) applied: separate gains / bundle costs / status quo as a loss / loss framing / large improbable prize / none
- Hypothesis and metric: what should move, and how will we know?

- [ ] Costs are shown as one total before confirmation, with the breakdown one tap away
- [ ] Any loss we name is real, calculated for the user and backed by a source
- [ ] Probabilities and guarantees are stated honestly; raffles have terms and legal review
- [ ] No confirmshaming, hidden fees, or nudging users toward riskier financial products

## Verification

What was checked or tested?

## Review

- [ ] One objective only

- [ ] Production was not modified directly
- [ ] Ready for human review
